description: Line 1 is a MSG of connection 1 recorded BEFORE connection 1 opens (line 2): MSG_CONN_UNKNOWN, although the connection is opened later. The MSG on line 3 is fine. The MSG of connection 9 (never opened, so it has no feed) is MSG_CONN_UNKNOWN too, and, being treated as a FORCE message (2.3c, the conservative reading), its ps_type anomaly is also reported by 7.7.
title: a MSG recorded before the first valid open, and a MSG of a connection that never opens
